hooks.command: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.cs$'); [ -n "$staged" ] && echo "$staged" | xargs csharpier format && echo "$staged" | xargs git add; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ]; then python3 -c 'import openpyxl' 2>/dev/null || pip install -q openpyxl >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; python3 tools/check_docs.py | tail -20; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking docs, readme map and card-art workbook...
